company_info.description: Vario Secure Inc. engages in the managed security and security equipment sales businesses in Japan. Its managed security services include router integrated security equipment, and operation and maintenance systems; integration services, such as design, procurement, installation, and configuration assistance, which covers range of modern network technology; and vulnerability diagnosis service provides web application, platform diagnosis, smartphone application diagnosis, and penetration testing to visualize security issues and propose solutions. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
